item.title: Bulldozers Plow Through Big Bend National Park, Sparking Fury in Texas
item.description:
📝 Customs and Border Protection (CBP) say the infrastructure is necessary to strengthen security in a region spanning hundreds of miles along the souther border. Recorded migrant encounter figures across the wider Big Bend Sector have fluctuated in recent years. Latest CBP data show Border Patrol recorded 148 encounters in the sector in June 2026, down from 412 in June 2023, during the peak of the border crisis.
🔗 Read more: https://www.newsweek.com/bulldozers-plow-through-big-bend-national-park-sparking-fury-in-texas-12295668

item.title: Show HN: Certo – An open source platform to deliver Open Badges
item.description:
📝 Certo Certo is a comprehensive digital credentials platform for issuing, managing, and verifying badges and certificates based on the Open Badges 3. 0 specification and the W3C Verifiable Credentials data model. Overview Certo is an open-source platform that enables organizations and individuals to issue verifiable digital credentials (badges and certificates) following global standards.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/schroedinger-Hat/certo
